title: sporobolus coromandelianus
intro: Sporobolus coromandelianus, commonly known as Indian grass, is a perennial grass species native to India and Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Indian grass include its ability to soothe digestive issues, lower blood sugar levels, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Sporobolus coromandelianus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
